findings.finding: Ishmael appears with noticeable facial stubble rather than clean-shaven as specified.
findings.visible_evidence: Shadowed texture along Ishmael’s cheeks and jawline suggests beard stubble.
findings.repair_prompt: Make Ishmael clean-shaven while retaining his dark hair, worn monkey jacket, plain shirt, rough trousers, and sea-scuffed boots.

findings.finding: Background painting reads as a clear seascape, which could be mistaken for the Spouter-Inn’s canonical smoke-dark abstract whaling painting.
findings.visible_evidence: Framed artwork on the left wall shows detailed ships on calm water, not a smoke-blackened abstract with a looming dark mass and three faint blue verticals.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the wall art with the smoke-blackened abstract whaling painting described in the contract or remove the painting to avoid confusion.

findings.finding: Large jawbone arch behind the bar is a prominent unscripted set piece that can pull focus from the primary action.
findings.visible_evidence: A curved bone structure with large teeth frames the landlord behind the counter.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove or de-emphasize the jawbone arch; keep background to shelves, bottles without readable labels, low beams, and cracked curios cases.

findings.finding: Readable numerals carved into the bench violate the no-readable-text directive.
findings.visible_evidence: On the front panel of the wooden bench, the numbers "12" are clearly legible.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove all legible alphanumeric carvings from the bench; retain only non-alphanumeric wear and whittling. Ensure there is no readable text anywhere in the frame.

findings.finding: The carpenter's plane appears metal-bodied rather than the specified wooden-bodied style.
findings.visible_evidence: The landlord holds a dark, smooth-sided plane that reads as an all-metal tool.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the tool with a sturdy wooden-bodied hand plane showing wood grain and an exposed iron blade/wedge; avoid an all-metal modern plane look.

findings.finding: The required candle prop is missing.
findings.visible_evidence: No candle or small holder is visible on tables, shelves, or near the stove.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a plain tallow candle in a small brass or tin holder on a nearby surface; keep the flame modest and avoid any labels; do not clutter the top-right caption zone.

findings.finding: Ishmael wears a knit cap not included in his described look.
findings.visible_evidence: The young man on the bench has a dark beanie covering his hair.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the knit cap so his dark hair is visible; keep him clean-shaven in a worn dark monkey jacket, rough trousers, and sea-scuffed boots.

findings.finding: Wood shavings are not near the bench as specified in supporting visuals.
findings.visible_evidence: Shavings appear mainly on the worktable and floor to the right, away from the bench area at left.
findings.repair_prompt: Scatter a light trail of wood shavings near the base of the bench to connect the bench area to the ongoing planing.

findings.finding: The chair meant to extend the bench is not clearly arranged as an extension.
findings.visible_evidence: The chair stands beside the bench with a visible gap and angled orientation instead of being flush.
findings.repair_prompt: Slide the chair tight against the bench end with the seat aligned to extend the length; keep Ishmael recoiling and clutching his coat.

findings.finding: Bottom-left caption zone is partially occupied by Ishmael’s coat and trousers, reducing clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The lower-left corner shows Ishmael’s dark clothing and his extended arm intruding toward that area; only a narrow sliver of blank wall remains.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose slightly to clear the bottom-left: nudge Ishmael and his pointing arm a bit right, or expand the blank wall margin on the lower-left; keep lighting and poses, preserve tight two-shot.

findings.finding: The ‘stick shaving on the landlord’s fingers’ is not clearly visible on his fingers; most shavings are on the tabletop.
findings.visible_evidence: Small wood curls lie on the table near the candle, while the landlord’s fingers appear mostly clean.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a thin, curling wood shaving draped over or pinched between the landlord’s fingers to emphasize mid-whittle detail.

findings.visible_evidence: No fireplace or paper-covered fireboard appears on any wall; left wall shows a lashed hammock and the opposite wall is bare.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a small hearth on one wall with a thin papered fireboard closing the opening; keep the paper pattern indistinct and without readable images or text.

findings.finding: Supporting visual of a rude shelf with odd bone hooks is missing.
findings.visible_evidence: Room walls appear plain aside from the hammock; no shelf or hooks are present.
findings.repair_prompt: Include a rough wooden shelf on a wall with a few primitive, bone-like hooks beneath it; keep them unobtrusive so the bed and characters remain primary.

findings.finding: Shaggy poncho-like cloak’s edge tags read as metallic clips rather than quill-like tags.
findings.visible_evidence: On the sea chest, the cloak has numerous shiny, uniform metal-looking fasteners along the fringe.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the cloak’s edging to show small quill-like, organic tags that could tinkle, avoiding shiny metal hardware; keep the garment thick and door-mat-like.

findings.finding: Bottom-right caption zone is busy and unsuitable for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The bottom-right corner contains a detailed sea chest with a tomahawk-pipe and wallet on top, plus textured floorboards—no clean negative space.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to leave a clear, low-detail negative space in the bottom-right quadrant for the caption. Shift the sea chest, pipe, and wallet leftward or crop them out; simplify/darken the floorboards in that corner. Maintain the over-bed angle, Ishmael at left in bed, Queequeg kneeling at the hearth, and all specified props elsewhere.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s skin tone deviates from the specified purplish-yellow cast.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg appears medium-brown under the warm candlelight rather than the described purplish-yellow.
findings.repair_prompt: Adjust Queequeg’s skin tonality toward a purplish-yellow cast while preserving the square tattoo patterns and warm candlelit shading.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s hairstyle is not a small scalp-knot on a mostly bald head.
findings.visible_evidence: He has a full head of hair gathered into a thick bun/ponytail, with no mostly-bald scalp visible.
findings.repair_prompt: Render Queequeg with a mostly bald scalp and a small scalp-knot; reduce hair volume while keeping his square-pattern tattoos and the tomahawk-pipe clenched in his teeth.

findings.finding: Background props risk confusion with story luggage.
findings.visible_evidence: A large wooden chest with a coil of rope sits in the left foreground and glass bottles are on the table; no soft canvas sea-bag is shown.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the hard-sided trunk and rope coil (and any bottle clutter if needed). If luggage is desired, replace with a weathered soft canvas sea-bag cinched with rope; keep background simple to avoid confusion.

findings.finding: Ash flecks from the pipe are not visible on the blanket.
findings.visible_evidence: The blanket surface beneath the pipe bowl appears clean with no specks.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a few subtle gray ash flecks on the blanket just below the tomahawk-pipe’s bowl; keep them small and sparse.
